judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A softly layered but badly overexposed sky with little drama and distracting foreground edges.
strengths: layered horizontal banding gives some depth
soft gradient from bright top to cooler base
faint hint of iridescence near the left
weaknesses: upper sky badly overexposed and washed out
chimney and treetop intrude at the edges
